intent_scope.summary: Add a one-click 'join conference' icon to the grid event cards.
intent_scope.key_gap: GridEvent already carries `conference` (url + label) and the view model already populates it, but neither grid card reads it. Three join affordances exist elsewhere in packages/web (UpNextCard link, UpNextBanner 'V' shortcut, EventForm EventDetailsSection link); none is on a grid card, and there is no shared join-URL helper.
intent_scope.sharpest_constraint: Drag/resize is owned by PointerCaptureBoundary via onPointerDownCapture, which calls preventDefault()+stopPropagation() at an ancestor in the CAPTURE phase. A nested interactive element inside a card cannot defend itself with its own stopPropagation; the repo's existing pattern for this is a data-attribute the view adapters check in getInteractionTarget (as resize handles do). EventCard.test.tsx renders the cards with no boundary above them, so unit tests alone cannot catch this.
